d: With the Union Cabinet clearing a path for all Agniveers undergoing training in the three services to join the Armed Forces as regular soldiers, the spotlight is now on the 75 per cent who will be offered a two-year extension at the end of a four-year tenure under the revamped Agnipath scheme. The Indian Express has learnt that a fairly stringent selection criteria is being discussed for those willing to join the services after serving this extension period.
